summary: Every legal input has at most ten decimal digits, which is too little variable work to support an honest runtime scaling verdict between plausible complexity classes.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer between 1 and 1000000000 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: Each iteration of the remotely accepted implementation removes exactly one decimal digit with division by ten, so it performs precisely D digit-extraction iterations.

The certificate regression exhaustively checks values 1 through 1000000 and 50000 deterministic values across the full legal range against an independent decimal-string digit-sum oracle; authored cases include the one- and ten-digit boundaries, zeroes, repetition, and distinct digits.
